risk_note: RV2 by path (orders, settlement rebate, commission estimates). The commission version follows the effective N (BR-CALC-02 settle ?? est) only, D10-578: after a settlement only a new estimate is archived with no new version (1); a settlement that arrives or changes moves the version and writes that version's rows at the new N (2), in the same column-plan UPDATE. update-step reports commission_moved from the plan and rebate uses it. A credited order's refresh revalues at the new N (BR-CALC-23 (a), B unchanged too), copying only when the version moved with no known N. A voided order (BASE_ZERO) still gets the rows of the version it moved to, so ADMIN_RESTORE can read them (Codex money r1 S1). Negative settlement clamps B to 0. No ledger entry, no balance change, no contract, no migration. Frozen tests changed under D10-327 / D10-650 / D10-655 (test-change-list.md), 33 unchanged frozen cases exempt by red_exempt (#2375). Known and accepted: an order R7 moved to N_new whose settlement later equals the original estimate keeps N_new rows (FU-R7-SETTLE-SAME-N, recorded for D).
